notes.title: Account system and subscription model + new Focus meditation
notes.content: We have moved away from single purchase meditations and toward a subscription model where users can buy a subscription through our mobile app and access all our premium content in mobile, web and in VR through one account for one fee. The first meditation in each category will continue to be free for all users.

notes.title: Update 2.0.4 is live with a hot new volcano meditation
notes.content:
2.0.4 update: We have added a hot new meditation featuring the live volcanic eruption in Geldingadalir Iceland. LetGo off anything you need to while dancing and screaming to Monsters and Men hit song Alligator while hot lava erupts in front of you.

All Flow users are encouraged to download our free Flow Meditation mobile app which is a perfect companion to the meditations in virtual reality, containing the same high quality content and allowing for meditation on the go. https://qrco.de/bbp41P

notes.title: Flow Playlist Update
notes.content:
Hi all you lovely people.

We have added the first version of the much requested playlist feature.
Now you can create a playlist of meditations, press play and go on your custom journey :)
And for those who want to stay in a setting after the meditation is over, now you can que up as many of the same meditation as you want and just mute the music and guidance on all but the first and stay in as long as you desire.

Love and peace,
The Flow team
